title: open source real time facial motion capture now on mobile, see comments for link
author: PDeperson

comments.author: PDeperson
comments.body:
Hey everyone! 👋 3D artists, 3D animators, or anyone interested in facial motion capture, I've created and refined this web app that does real-time facial motion absolutely for free! 🤩

Try it here: 👇
https://facemocap.vercel.app

It's open source! Find it on GitHub here: 💻
https://github.com/PooyaDeperson/facial-motion-capture

#Artists #Animators #MotionCapture #Webapp #Free #OpenSource #Technology #Development #GitHub

comments.author: Lazy_Firefighter5353
comments.body: Don't know what happened but I only tried it at least 2 or 3 minutes then it crashed.

replies.author: PDeperson
replies.body: Oh, how did it crash? Did the character's neck snap back and stop?

replies.author: PDeperson
replies.body: I checked that there are currently 45 active users on the web app. Unfortunately, this is an open-source, free project, and I don't think it can handle such an amount of users. sorry

comments.author: HoddOfficial
comments.body: Looks nice! But i’d mirror the camera. Makes the use way more user friendly. If you don’t want that, you could add a button to switch between mirrored and unmirrored as well. To me, it would feel way more natural if the character moves the direction I am facing

replies.author: PDeperson
replies.body: Hi, thanks for the suggestion. Of course, I'm going to add it to my to-do list just now. It's fairly easy to do. Do you have more suggestions, maybe?

replies.author: PDeperson
replies.body:
By the way, in case you're interested, the project's source code and roadmap are here:
 https://github.com/PooyaDeperson/facial-motion-capture

replies.author: PDeperson
replies.body: Hey, the mirror camera interactions is added. thank you for the suggestion.
